```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, results = "hide")

input_file <- knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)
has_input_file <- !is.null(input_file) &&
  length(input_file) > 0 &&
  !is.na(input_file) &&
  nzchar(input_file)

if (has_input_file) {
  input_dir <- dirname(normalizePath(input_file, mustWork = FALSE))
  project_dir <- if (basename(input_dir) == "code") {
    normalizePath(file.path(input_dir, ".."), mustWork = TRUE)
  } else {
    normalizePath(input_dir, mustWork = TRUE)
  }
} else {
  cwd <- normalizePath(getwd(), mustWork = TRUE)
  project_dir <- if (basename(cwd) == "code") {
    normalizePath(file.path(cwd, ".."), mustWork = TRUE)
  } else {
    cwd
  }
}

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = project_dir)
setwd(project_dir)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tximport)
  library(DESeq2)
  library(WGCNA)
  library(tidyverse)
  library(clusterProfiler)
  library(pheatmap)
  library(Mfuzz)
  library(Biobase)
  library(scales)
  library(igraph)
  library(ggraph)
  library(tidygraph)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(jsonlite)
})


options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
WGCNA::allowWGCNAThreads()

rdata_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "RData")
dir.create(rdata_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

rds_file <- function(name) {
  file.path(rdata_dir, paste0(name, ".rds"))
}

cache_or_run <- function(name, expr, refresh = FALSE) {
  path <- rds_file(name)
  if (file.exists(path) && !refresh) {
    message("Loading cached object: ", path)
    readRDS(path)
  } else {
    message("Running and saving object: ", path)
    value <- force(expr)
    saveRDS(value, path)
    value
  }
}

load_rds_object <- function(name, required = TRUE) {
  path <- rds_file(name)
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    if (required) stop("Missing cached object: ", path)
    return(NULL)
  }
  readRDS(path)
}

load_rds_list <- function(name, required = TRUE, envir = .GlobalEnv) {
  value <- load_rds_object(name, required = required)
  if (!is.null(value)) list2env(value, envir = envir)
  invisible(value)
}

analysis_file <- function(...) {
  file.path(rdata_dir, ...)
}

input_file_path <- function(...) {
  cached <- file.path(rdata_dir, ...)
  if (file.exists(cached)) return(cached)
  file.path(project_dir, ...)
}

show_table <- function(x, n = 20, title = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(title)) {
    cat("\n### ", title, "\n\n", sep = "")
  }
  if (is.null(x)) {
    cat("No object available.\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  df <- as.data.frame(x)
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    cat("No rows.\n")
    return(invisible(df))
  }
  print(utils::head(df, n))
  invisible(df)
}

show_plot_files <- function(paths) {
  paths <- paths[file.exists(paths)]
  if (length(paths) == 0) {
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  paths <- normalizePath(paths, mustWork = TRUE)
  knitr::include_graphics(paths)
}
```

```{r}
############################################################
## Step Z-A. Subnetwork figure A: red module
############################################################

outdir_subnet <- file.path(outdir, "subnetwork_figures")
dir.create(outdir_subnet, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

red_edges <- network_edges %>% dplyr::filter(Module == "red")
red_nodes <- nodes %>%
  dplyr::filter(Gene %in% unique(c(red_edges$Source, red_edges$Target)))

g_red <- tbl_graph(
  nodes = red_nodes %>%
    dplyr::select(name = Gene, NodeClass, Type, Degree, abs_kME),
  edges = red_edges %>%
    dplyr::select(from = Source, to = Target, abs_cor, Direction),
  directed = FALSE
)

p_red <- ggraph(g_red, layout = "fr") +
  geom_edge_link(aes(edge_alpha = abs_cor, edge_color = Direction), edge_width = 0.4) +
  scale_edge_color_manual(values = c(positive = "#888888", negative = "#D55E00")) +
  geom_node_point(aes(color = NodeClass, size = Degree)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    Seed_DE_NLR = "#D62728",
    Other_TCR_NLR = "#FF7F0E",
    Coexpressed_gene = "#1F77B4"
  )) +
  geom_node_text(
    aes(label = ifelse(NodeClass == "Seed_DE_NLR", name, NA)),
    repel = TRUE,
    size = 2.5,
    max.overlaps = 30
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1.5, 7)) +
  theme_void(base_size = 12) +
  labs(
    title = "A. Red module NLR-centered co-expression network",
    subtitle = sprintf("%d nodes, %d edges; seed NLRs labeled", nrow(red_nodes), nrow(red_edges))
  )

print(p_red)
ggsave(file.path(outdir_subnet, "Subnet_A_red_module.pdf"), p_red, width = 9, height = 7)
ggsave(file.path(outdir_subnet, "Subnet_A_red_module.png"), p_red, width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```
```{r}
############################################################
## Step Z-B. Subnetwork figure B: top hub NLR + neighbors
############################################################

top_n_hubs <- 12
top_hub_genes <- nlr_seed_hub_ranking %>%
  dplyr::arrange(HubRank) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = top_n_hubs) %>%
  pull(Gene)

hub_edges <- network_edges %>%
  dplyr::filter(Source %in% top_hub_genes | Target %in% top_hub_genes)
hub_nodes <- nodes %>%
  dplyr::filter(Gene %in% unique(c(hub_edges$Source, hub_edges$Target))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(IsTopHub = Gene %in% top_hub_genes)

g_hub <- tbl_graph(
  nodes = hub_nodes %>%
    dplyr::select(name = Gene, NodeClass, Type, Module, Degree, IsTopHub),
  edges = hub_edges %>%
    dplyr::select(from = Source, to = Target, abs_cor, Direction),
  directed = FALSE
)

p_hub <- ggraph(g_hub, layout = "fr") +
  geom_edge_link(aes(edge_alpha = abs_cor, edge_color = Direction), edge_width = 0.4) +
  scale_edge_color_manual(values = c(positive = "#888888", negative = "#D55E00")) +
  geom_node_point(aes(color = Module, size = ifelse(IsTopHub, 7, 2))) +
  geom_node_text(
    aes(label = ifelse(IsTopHub, name, NA)),
    repel = TRUE,
    size = 3,
    fontface = "bold",
    max.overlaps = 30
  ) +
  scale_size_identity() +
  theme_void(base_size = 12) +
  labs(
    title = sprintf("B. Top-%d hub NLR subnetwork", top_n_hubs),
    subtitle = sprintf("%d nodes, %d edges; large nodes = top-hub NLRs", nrow(hub_nodes), nrow(hub_edges))
  )

print(p_hub)
ggsave(file.path(outdir_subnet, "Subnet_B_top_hub.pdf"), p_hub, width = 10, height = 8)
ggsave(file.path(outdir_subnet, "Subnet_B_top_hub.png"), p_hub, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
############################################################
## Step Z-C. Subnetwork figure C: top hub NLR expression trends
############################################################

hub_expr   <- expr_matrix[intersect(top_hub_genes, rownames(expr_matrix)), ,
                          drop = FALSE]
hub_expr_z <- t(scale(t(hub_expr)))

sample_meta <- as.data.frame(colData(dds)) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Sample") %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample, time)

hub_long <- as.data.frame(hub_expr_z) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Gene") %>%
  pivot_longer(-Gene, names_to = "Sample", values_to = "z_VST") %>%
  left_join(sample_meta, by = "Sample") %>%
  left_join(
    nlr_seed_hub_ranking %>% dplyr::select(Gene, Type, HubRank, Module),
    by = "Gene"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Gene_label = sprintf("[%d] %s (%s)", HubRank, Gene, Type),
    time = factor(time, levels = c("0d", "2d", "5d", "8d"))
  )

hub_mean <- hub_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Gene, Gene_label, Type, HubRank, time) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(z_mean = mean(z_VST),
                   z_sd   = sd(z_VST),
                   .groups = "drop")

p_trend <- ggplot(hub_mean,
                  aes(x = time, y = z_mean,
                      group = Gene_label, color = Type)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = z_mean - z_sd, ymax = z_mean + z_sd),
                width = 0.15, alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ reorder(Gene_label, HubRank), ncol = 4) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(TNL = "#7B3294",
                                CNL = "#008837",
                                RNL = "#E66101")) +
  labs(title    = sprintf("C. Expression trends of top-%d hub NLRs", top_n_hubs),
       subtitle = "Per-gene z-scored VST; mean +/- SD across 3 reps",
       x = "Time post-inoculation", y = "Z-scored VST expression") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 9),
        legend.position = "top")

print(p_trend)
ggsave(file.path(outdir_subnet, "Subnet_C_top_hub_expression_trends.pdf"),
       p_trend, width = 11, height = 7)
ggsave(file.path(outdir_subnet, "Subnet_C_top_hub_expression_trends.png"),
       p_trend, width = 11, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
############################################################
## Step Z-D. Functional annotation summary of network target genes
############################################################

target_summary_genes <- nodes %>%
  dplyr::filter(NodeClass == "Coexpressed_gene") %>%
  pull(Gene)
cat("Target (non-NLR) genes in network:", length(target_summary_genes), "\n")

target_anno <- anno %>%
  dplyr::filter(Gene %in% target_summary_genes) %>%
  dplyr::select(any_of(c("Gene", "Preferred_name", "Description",
                         "KEGG_Pathway", "GOs", "PFAMs")))
write_tsv(target_anno,
          file.path(outdir_subnet, "Target_gene_full_annotation.tsv"))


target_kegg <- target_anno %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene, KEGG_Pathway) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(KEGG_Pathway), KEGG_Pathway != "-") %>%
  separate_rows(KEGG_Pathway, sep = ",") %>%
  dplyr::filter(grepl("^ko[0-9]+", KEGG_Pathway)) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(term2name, by = c("KEGG_Pathway" = "Pathway")) %>%
  dplyr::count(KEGG_Pathway, Name, sort = TRUE) %>%
  head(20)

p_kegg_targets <- ggplot(target_kegg,
                         aes(x = n, y = reorder(Name, n))) +
  geom_col(fill = "#1F77B4") +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), hjust = -0.15, size = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(c(0, 0.15))) +
  labs(title = "D-1. Top KEGG pathways among NLR-network target genes",
       x = "Number of target genes", y = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11)

print(p_kegg_targets)
ggsave(file.path(outdir_subnet, "Subnet_D1_target_KEGG_pathways.pdf"),
       p_kegg_targets, width = 8, height = 6)


target_kegg_enrich <- enricher(
  gene      = target_summary_genes,
  universe  = gene_module_df_clean$Gene,
  TERM2GENE = gene2kegg,
  TERM2NAME = term2name,
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
  qvalueCutoff = 0.2
)

if (!is.null(target_kegg_enrich) && nrow(target_kegg_enrich) > 0) {
  p_target_enrich <- dotplot(
    target_kegg_enrich,
    showCategory = 15,
    title = "D-2. KEGG enrichment of NLR-network target genes"
  )
  print(p_target_enrich)
  ggsave(file.path(outdir_subnet, "Subnet_D2_target_KEGG_enrichment.pdf"),
         p_target_enrich, width = 9, height = 6)
  
  write_tsv(as.data.frame(target_kegg_enrich),
            file.path(outdir_subnet, "Subnet_D2_target_KEGG_enrichment_table.tsv"))
} else {
  cat("Note: target gene set has no significant KEGG enrichment.\n")
}


per_nlr_targets <- top_targets_by_NLR %>%
  dplyr::filter(Source %in% top_hub_genes) %>%
  dplyr::select(Source, Target, abs_cor, Direction,
                any_of(c("Preferred_name", "Description", "KEGG_Pathway"))) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Source, desc(abs_cor))

write_tsv(per_nlr_targets,
          file.path(outdir_subnet, "Subnet_D3_per_top_hub_NLR_targets.tsv"))

cat("\n===== Top 5 targets per top-hub NLR (preview) =====\n")
per_nlr_targets %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Source) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 5) %>%
```

```{r}
############################################################
## Step Z-E. GO BP enrichment for NEGATIVE-edge target genes
##   in negative-dominant modules (green, lightyellow)
##
############################################################

outdir_negedge <- file.path(outdir_subnet, "negative_edge_GO_BP")
dir.create(outdir_negedge, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)


negative_modules <- c("green", "lightyellow")

for (mod in negative_modules) {
  
  mod_neg_edges <- network_edges %>%
    dplyr::filter(Module == mod, Direction == "negative")
  
  if (nrow(mod_neg_edges) == 0) {
    message("Module ", mod, ": no negative edges, skipped.")
    next
  }
  
  neg_targets <- mod_neg_edges %>%
    dplyr::filter(!Target %in% nlr_master$Gene) %>%
    pull(Target) %>%
    unique()
  
  cat(sprintf("\nModule %s: %d unique negative-edge target genes\n",
              mod, length(neg_targets)))
  
  if (length(neg_targets) < 10) {
    message("Too few negative targets in ", mod, ", skipped.")
    next
  }
  
go_neg <- enricher(
    gene         = neg_targets,
    universe     = gene_module_df_clean$Gene,
    TERM2GENE    = gene2go,
    TERM2NAME    = go2name,
    pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
    qvalueCutoff = 0.2
  )
  
  if (is.null(go_neg) || nrow(go_neg) == 0) {
    message("Module ", mod, ": no significant GO term in negative targets.")
    next
  }
  
  write_tsv(as.data.frame(go_neg),
            file.path(outdir_negedge,
                      paste0("GO_negedge_targets_", mod, "_table.tsv")))
  
  # dotplot
  p_neg_go <- dotplot(
    go_neg,
    showCategory = 15,
    title = paste0("GO enrichment of NEGATIVE-edge targets - ",
                   mod, " module")
  )
  
  print(p_neg_go)
  
  ggsave(file.path(outdir_negedge,
                   paste0("GO_negedge_targets_", mod, ".pdf")),
         p_neg_go, width = 9, height = 6.5)
  ggsave(file.path(outdir_negedge,
                   paste0("GO_negedge_targets_", mod, ".png")),
         p_neg_go, width = 9, height = 6.5, dpi = 300)
}


## -----------------------------
## -----------------------------

for (mod in negative_modules) {
  
  pos_targets <- network_edges %>%
    dplyr::filter(Module == mod, Direction == "positive",
                  !Target %in% nlr_master$Gene) %>%
    pull(Target) %>% unique()
  
  if (length(pos_targets) < 10) next
  
go_pos <- enricher(
    gene         = pos_targets,
    universe     = gene_module_df_clean$Gene,
    TERM2GENE    = gene2go,
    TERM2NAME    = go2name,
    pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
    qvalueCutoff = 0.2
  )
  
  if (!is.null(go_pos) && nrow(go_pos) > 0) {
    p_pos_go <- dotplot(
      go_pos, showCategory = 15,
      title = paste0("GO enrichment of POSITIVE-edge targets - ",
                     mod, " module (control)")
    )
    print(p_pos_go)
    
    write_tsv(as.data.frame(go_pos),
              file.path(outdir_negedge,
                        paste0("GO_posedge_targets_", mod, "_table.tsv")))
    ggsave(file.path(outdir_negedge,
                     paste0("GO_posedge_targets_", mod, ".pdf")),
           p_pos_go, width = 9, height = 6.5)
  }
}
```

```{r}
############################################################
## Step Z-F. Sensor-Helper case study:
##   Pt5G50680 (CNL sensor) <-> Pt6G26210 (ADR1 helper)
############################################################

outdir_pair <- file.path(outdir_subnet, "case_Pt5G50680_ADR1")
dir.create(outdir_pair, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

sensor_id <- "Pt5G50680"
helper_id <- "Pt6G26210"
pair_ids  <- c(sensor_id, helper_id)

sample_meta <- as.data.frame(colData(dds)) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Sample") %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample, time)

pair_vst <- as.data.frame(expr_matrix[pair_ids, , drop = FALSE]) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Gene") %>%
  pivot_longer(-Gene, names_to = "Sample", values_to = "VST") %>%
  left_join(sample_meta, by = "Sample") %>%
  mutate(
    GeneLabel = case_when(
      Gene == sensor_id ~ paste0(sensor_id, " (CNL, 8d-down)"),
      Gene == helper_id ~ paste0(helper_id, " (CNL/RNL-intermediate)")
      ),
    time = factor(time, levels = c("0d", "2d", "5d", "8d"))
  )

pair_vst_mean <- pair_vst %>%
  group_by(Gene, GeneLabel, time) %>%
  summarise(mean_vst = mean(VST), sd_vst = sd(VST), .groups = "drop")

p_pair_vst <- ggplot(pair_vst_mean,
                     aes(x = time, y = mean_vst, color = GeneLabel, group = GeneLabel)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_vst - sd_vst, ymax = mean_vst + sd_vst), width = 0.15) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    setNames("#008837", paste0(sensor_id, " (CNL sensor)")),
    setNames("#E66101", paste0(helper_id, " (ADR1-like helper)"))
  )) +
  labs(title = "Sensor-Helper expression dynamics",
       x = "Time post-inoculation",
       y = "VST expression (mean +/- SD, n = 3)",
       color = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

print(p_pair_vst)
ggsave(file.path(outdir_pair, "Pair_A_VST_trends.pdf"), p_pair_vst, width = 6.5, height = 4.5)
ggsave(file.path(outdir_pair, "Pair_A_VST_trends.png"), p_pair_vst, width = 6.5, height = 4.5, dpi = 300)

scatter_df <- as.data.frame(t(expr_matrix[pair_ids, , drop = FALSE])) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Sample") %>%
  setNames(c("Sample", "sensor_VST", "helper_VST")) %>%
  left_join(sample_meta, by = "Sample")

cor_val <- cor(scatter_df$sensor_VST, scatter_df$helper_VST, method = "spearman")

p_pair_scatter <- ggplot(scatter_df, aes(x = sensor_VST, y = helper_VST, color = time, label = Sample)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, linewidth = 0.4, color = "grey40", fill = "grey85") +
  geom_point(size = 3.5) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(size = 2.8, color = "black", segment.size = 0.2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("0d" = "#1F77B4", "2d" = "#FF7F0E",
                                "5d" = "#2CA02C", "8d" = "#D62728")) +
  labs(title = "Sensor-Helper sample-level coexpression",
       subtitle = sprintf(
  "Co-repressed pair from 8d-down group, Spearman = +%.3f",
  cor_val
),
       x = paste0(sensor_id, " VST (CNL sensor)"),
       y = paste0(helper_id, " VST (ADR1-like helper)"),
       color = "Time") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12)

print(p_pair_scatter)
ggsave(file.path(outdir_pair, "Pair_B_scatter.pdf"), p_pair_scatter, width = 6, height = 5)
ggsave(file.path(outdir_pair, "Pair_B_scatter.png"), p_pair_scatter, width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 300)

neigh_sensor <- network_edges %>%
  dplyr::filter(Source == sensor_id | Target == sensor_id) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Neighbor = ifelse(Source == sensor_id, Target, Source))
neigh_helper <- network_edges %>%
  dplyr::filter(Source == helper_id | Target == helper_id) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Neighbor = ifelse(Source == helper_id, Target, Source))

common_neighbors <- intersect(neigh_sensor$Neighbor, neigh_helper$Neighbor)
local_nodes_set <- c(pair_ids, head(common_neighbors[order(-neigh_sensor$abs_cor[
  match(common_neighbors, neigh_sensor$Neighbor)])], 25))

local_edges <- network_edges %>%
  dplyr::filter(Source %in% local_nodes_set, Target %in% local_nodes_set)
local_node_meta <- nodes %>%
  dplyr::filter(Gene %in% local_nodes_set) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Role = case_when(
      Gene == sensor_id ~ "Sensor (CNL)",
      Gene == helper_id ~ "Helper (ADR1-like)",
      Gene %in% nlr_master$Gene ~ "Other NLR",
      TRUE ~ "Common neighbor"
    )
  )

edge_local <- local_edges %>%
  dplyr::transmute(from = Source, to = Target, weight = abs_cor, Direction)
vertex_local <- local_node_meta %>%
  dplyr::transmute(name = Gene, Role, Degree)

g_local <- graph_from_data_frame(edge_local, directed = FALSE, vertices = vertex_local)
set.seed(3)
pdf(file.path(outdir_pair, "Pair_C_local_network.pdf"), width = 8, height = 6.5)
plot(
  g_local,
  layout = layout_with_fr(g_local),
  vertex.label = V(g_local)$name,
  vertex.color = recode(V(g_local)$Role,
    `Sensor (CNL)` = "#008837",
    `Helper (ADR1-like)` = "#E66101",
    `Other NLR` = "#7B3294",
    `Common neighbor` = "#1F77B4",
    .default = "grey70"
  ),
  vertex.size = pmax(5, sqrt(V(g_local)$Degree + 1) * 2),
  edge.color = ifelse(E(g_local)$Direction == "negative", "#D55E00", "#888888"),
  edge.width = pmax(0.5, E(g_local)$weight * 2),
  main = "Sensor-Helper local network"
)
dev.off()

pair_anno <- anno %>%
  dplyr::filter(Gene %in% pair_ids) %>%
  dplyr::select(any_of(c("Gene", "Preferred_name", "Description",
                         "PFAMs", "KEGG_Pathway", "GOs")))
print(pair_anno)
write_tsv(pair_anno, file.path(outdir_pair, "Pair_annotation.tsv"))
```
